subject: Request: H100 reservation + temporary burst protection for Novum pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@novumhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novumhealth.com>, Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@novumhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: H100 reservation + temporary burst protection for Novum pilot

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re preparing the pilot launch in early September and need to lock down a few dedicated capacity items before procurement can sign the SOW. Can you confirm the following and send a short note for our procurement/legal review?

What we need:
- Reservation of H100 family GPUs (8x) for a dedicated pool, starting 2027-09-01.
- Temporary burst protection for first 6 weeks of go-live: ability to exceed reservation by up to 60% without immediate overage charge shock.
- A cap on overage rate during that 6-week window (we’d propose max 1.5x list rate).
- Option to convert to a lower-cost accelerator after pilot if utilization is under 40%.

Attached is the SOW (v3) and our forecast spreadsheet for expected token volumes. Our procurement team also asked whether Redwood can accommodate a staggered billing cadence for the first two months (biweekly true-ups) to smooth cashflow.

If you can get this routed for executive approval today/tomorrow, procurement will provision signatures quickly.

Appreciate it —
Hannah

--
Hannah Cole
Director of Platform Engineering
Novum Health
Attachments: Novum_SOW_v3.pdf, novum_usage_forecast_Q3.xlsx

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@novumhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: H100 reservation + temporary burst protection for Novum pilot

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the SOW/forecast. Looping in Lauren (Revenue Lead) and Karthik (Deal Desk) to approve a nonstandard reservation/overage arrangement. Quick summary of Novum’s request so we’re all aligned:

- 8x H100 reserved pool starting 2027-09-01
- Temporary burst allowance +60% for first 6 weeks
- Overage cap requested at 1.5x list for that window
- Option to down-shift to a lower-cost accelerator if utilization <40% after pilot
- Staggered/biweekly billing true-ups for first two months

Karthik/Laura — can you advise: 1) whether we can approve H100 reservation for a pilot (nonstandard SKU for this contract), 2) whether we can accept a capped overage at 1.5x for the 6-week window, and 3) whether we can offer biweekly true-ups operationally? If full approval isn’t possible, please propose what we can commit to so I can give Hannah procurement a clear yes/no and next steps.

I’ve attached the same SOW and forecast for your review.

Thanks —
Sergio
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novum_SOW_v3.pdf, novum_usage_forecast_Q3.xlsx

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: H100 reservation + temporary burst protection for Novum pilot

Sergio / Karthik —

I reviewed the ask and the attached forecast. Given Novum’s strategic fit and the pilot timeline, I’m comfortable approving a constrained exception with the following conditions (must be captured in an amendment to the SOW and signed before 2027-08-27):

1) Hardware: Approve reservation of 8x H100 family accelerators for the requested start date. This is a one-time, pilot-only SKU reservation tied to DEAL-3491.

2) Temporary burst buffer: Allow up to +60% burst above the reservation for a 6-week window starting 2027-09-01. During that window we will apply an overage rate cap of 1.4x standard list (reduced from the requested 1.5x).

3) Billing cadence: Approve biweekly true-ups for the first 8 weeks (four biweekly cycles) to smooth invoicing. Finance must confirm operational readiness for biweekly invoices before signature; Karthik, please coordinate with Finance and confirm by 2027-08-20.

4) Pricing concession: Provide a one-time 10% discount on reservation fees for month 1 of the pilot as a go-live concession. This is not renewable and applies only to the initial reservation month.

5) Downshift option: Allow Novum to request conversion to a lower-cost accelerator after week 6 if utilization average <40%. Any SKU swap requires 14 days notice and may incur a pro-rated reallocation fee.

6) Reporting & usage commit: Novum must provide weekly usage reports during the 6-week window. If usage materially exceeds the forecast (>30% variance) Redwood reserves the right to pause burst protection with 48h notice.

7) Documentation: Karthik, work with Legal to prepare an amendment capturing the above terms and the revised pricing. SalesOps: include the updated forecast and proposed invoice schedule in HubSpot.

I’m copying Karthik to finalize Finance signoff and Legal for the amendment. Once we have signed amendment and Finance confirmation, Sergio can send the signed terms to Novum.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Internal note: Approve exception for strategic pilot. Limit exposure with a 1.4x cap and strict reporting — this should be manageable given forecast figures.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novumhealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: H100 reservation + temporary burst protection for Novum pilot

Hannah —

Good news: leadership has approved a constrained exception for the pilot. Summary of approved items (please review and let me know if procurement/legal want any clarifications):

- 8x H100 reservation starting 2027-09-01 (pilot-only SKU).
- Temporary burst allowance up to +60% for 6 weeks with an overage cap of 1.4x list rate for that period.
- Biweekly billing true-ups for the first 8 weeks (four cycles) to smooth cashflow — Finance is validating operational readiness now.
- One-time 10% discount on reservation fees for month 1 as a go-live concession.
- Option to downshift to a lower-cost accelerator after week 6 if utilization average <40% (14 days notice + potential reallocation fee).

Next steps:
1) I’ll ask Legal to send an amendment reflecting these terms. Karthik will confirm Finance signoff and finalize invoice cadence by EOD 2027-08-20.
2) Once amendment is signed, we’ll provision the reservation and enable burst protection on 2027-09-01.

For your records I’ve attached the SOW we have and the usage forecast you shared. I’m also dropping the DocuSign link (once Legal issues the amendment) and the HubSpot deal so you and procurement can track.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 15m call tomorrow if procurement wants to walk through the amendment.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novum_SOW_v3.pdf, novum_usage_forecast_Q3.xlsx
